OUT=Path('/workspace/scratch/7542f0d861f1/experiments')

STAT=Path('/tmp/pr753-stationary-inputs')
BINS={'ou2':Path('/tmp/pr753-next/ou2-probe'),'ou3':Path('/tmp/pr753-time-scale/ou3-probe'),'tfg':Path('/tmp/pr753-next/tfg-probe')}

ARMS={'baseline':{},'no_sync':{'W3D_AW_COV_SYNC':'reconfigure','TFG_AW_COV_SYNC':'0'},'slower_commits':{'OU_ADAPT_EVERY_SECS':'0.5'}}
KEYS=['disp_z_pct_hs','disp_3d_rms_m','roll_rms_deg','pitch_rms_deg','yaw_rms_deg','accel_bias_3d_rms_mps2']
def run(job):
 family,dataset,name,arm=job
 env={k:v for k,v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith(('W3D_','SF_','OU_','TFG_','PROBE_'))};env.update(W3D_COLLECT_ALL_GATES='1',W3D_WRITE_TIMESERIES='0',W3D_VALIDATION_WINDOW_SEC='900');env.update(ARMS[arm])
 if dataset=='stationary':env['W3D_REFERENCE_MOTION']='stationary'
 with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(dir=OUT) as tmp:
  p=Path(tmp);(p/name).symlink_to((STAT if dataset=='stationary' else MOV)/name)
  r=subprocess.run([str(BINS[family]),'--input',name],cwd=p,env=env,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=300)
 lines=[l for l in r.stdout.splitlines() if l.startswith('VALIDATION_METRICS ')]
 if len(lines)!=1:raise RuntimeError((job,r.returncode,r.stderr))
 m=dict(x.split('=',1) for x in lines[0].split()[1:]);v={k:float(m[k]) for k in KEYS}
 row=dict(family=family,dataset=dataset,input=name,arm=arm,metrics=v,exit_code=r.returncode)
 print(family,dataset,name.split('_H')[1][:5],arm,v,flush=True);return row
if __name__=='__main__':
 jobs=[(f,d,n,a) for f in BINS for d in ['stationary','moving'] for n in NAMES for a in ARMS if not(f=='tfg' and a=='slower_commits')]
 rows=[]
 with ThreadPoolExecutor(3) as pool:
  for fut in as_completed([pool.submit(run,j) for j in jobs]):
   rows.append(fut.result());(OUT/'covariance_screen.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(role='diagnostic only',rows=rows),indent=2)+'\n')
